podcast.title: Co-founder of Roadies of Color United
podcast.body: In 2009, Casey Jackson co-founded Roadies of Color United, an organization dedicated to supporting and creating opportunities for people of color interested in pursuing careers in the live touring business. "And he is also the co-founder of Rodeys of Color United, an organization formed in 2009 to help people of color interested in the live touring business."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: We Are The Road Crew - A History of Roadies

podcast.title: One of Few Black Roadies
podcast.body: Casey Jackson is noted as one of the few black roadies in the music business, operating in a profession historically dominated by white males. "He's one of the few black roadies in the business."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: We Are The Road Crew - A History of Roadies

podcast.title: Roadie for Major Pop and R&B Acts
podcast.body: Casey Jackson has worked as a roadie for prominent artists in the pop and R&B genres, including Justin Bieber, Prince, and Destiny's Child, highlighting his significant experience in the industry. "He's been on the road with Justin Bieber, Prince, Destinay's child and many others."
